I have implemented and committed the solution on the `fix/persister-restore` branch:

### Summary of Changes
1. **`@tanstack/query-core` Restored Snapshot Support**:
   - Exported [`createPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L53-L65) (along with [`isPersisterRestoreResult`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L67-L76), [`createRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L93-L143), and [`PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L38-L40)) from [`packages/query-core/src/index.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-core/src/index.ts#L22-L29) and updated [`QueryPersister`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-core/src/types.ts#L127-L147) to allow returning a `PersisterRestoreResult`.
   - Updated [`Query.fetch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-core/src/query.ts#L687-L698) so that when `this.#retryer.start()` resolves with a `PersisterRestoreResult`, the query adopts the restored `QueryState` via `this.setState(restoredState, { meta: PERSISTER_RESTORE_RESULT_SYMBOL })` with `fetchStatus: 'idle'` instead of treating the result as a fresh fetch (`setData`) or invoking cache `onSuccess`/`onSettled` callbacks.
   - Updated [`QueryObserver`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-core/src/queryObserver.ts#L646-L651) so restored queries preserve their persisted status, `isRefetchError`, `isStale`, `failureCount`, `failureReason`, `dataUpdatedAt`, `errorUpdatedAt`, and infinite-query pagination state (`pages`, `pageParams`) on mount and while `isRestoring` is active.

2. **`@tanstack/query-persist-client-core` Single & Bulk Restoration**:
   - Updated [`persisterFn`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L218-L291) in [`createPersister.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts) to return `createPersisterRestoreResult({ data, state })` and avoid overwriting restored snapshot metadata.
   - Updated [`restoreQueries`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L387-L465) and added [`reconcileRestoredQueryState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/createPersister.ts#L66-L120) so bulk restoration preserves the full persisted `QueryState` and reconciles existing in-memory queries by merging data freshness (`dataUpdatedAt`) and error freshness (`errorUpdatedAt`) independently.

3. **Framework Adapter Compatibility & Tests**:
   - Updated [`useBaseQuery.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/vue-query/src/useBaseQuery.ts#L118-L135) and [`useQueries.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/vue-query/src/useQueries.ts#L223-L238) in `@tanstack/vue-query` to subscribe observers when used with a core `QueryClient` instance.
   - Added unit and integration tests in [`query.test.tsx`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-core/src/__tests__/query.test.tsx#L1380-L1490), [`createPersister.test.ts`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/query-persist-client-core/src/__tests__/createPersister.test.ts#L678-L905), [`react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/react-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx#L179-L300), and [`preact-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-z0aqxywq/packages/preact-query/src/__tests__/fine-grained-persister.test.tsx#L180-L296).
